components.name: Quantyra optical fixture system
components.role: Source stand, dual-jig cradle and ambient hood

licenses.scope: Fixture CAD/hardware, meshes, G-code and documentation

compatibility.alignment: Preferred 34 mm stand: source center X=-5, 0 or +5 relative to fixed dual body; physical mapping must be checked. Supported 32 mm narrow stand requires separately measured lateral placement.
compatibility.stand_gcode_note: Current stand G-code is dimensionally consistent with the preferred 34 mm stand; exact source slicing is not established. The supported 32 mm narrow STL has no current G-code and requires re-slicing.

status.physical: User reports hood printing well after PETG profile correction; assembled fit and shielding pending.
limitations: CAD dimensions are not measured fit
IR opacity and optical performance unvalidated
